_doc: The castle's secrets (docs/architecture.md 'Secrets and the map'; sim_core::secrets). `secrets`: the five hidden passages, each a shortcut. `id` is stable (the database's discoveries.secret and GET /api/map), `num` (1..) the reward ledgers' ref_id, `name` our own (shown only once found), `entrance` the walk-through piece on its public ends (castle_kit/grid.py ENTRANCE_STYLES), `surfaces` every layout surface of the passage (all `secret: true`, each in one secret only), `doors` its two door surfaces (in the walls of the rooms it joins). Standing on any of its surfaces the first time discovers it, once per character: `reward.xp` (XP source explore), one House Cup point from the `find` source under its daily cap, and `reward.recipe` (a recipe learned, data/crafting/recipes.json) for two of them. `wishing_room`: the Wishing Room: pace between the two `marks` (pace_mark areas across the `corridor`) `passes` times within `window_s` and the `door` interactable opens for you for `door_open_s`; inside you choose one of `rooms` (protocol::WishingRoomKind ids, their instance layouts), up to `capacity` people in one opener's room.
